title: A codex secret, held but untouched
watchFor: Oria holds a linked codex secret (what the sealed case holds) on her sheet, but nothing said touches it. Nobody should keep it: no `keeps` for oria-senn.the-case in the plan, no tell about steering talk back to the fee, no mention of the control core or what's in the case. The talk should stay on what was actually said.
turns: Are the dumplings here really as good as everyone says, Oria?
Brask, how's the workshop on the lower stairs these days?
Vex, what's the strangest thing you've ever carried?
